description: Use this when the user wants to check how a property search request is understood before searching. Shows the request as structured criteria the user can check and correct. The text is processed by an AI service (Anthropic API) to extract the criteria; Objelio does not link it to a person. Does not search.

text.description: The user's request in their own words.

name: explain_criteria

kriterien.description: Structured criteria, can be passed as criteria to search_listings (leave out null and empty fields).
